title: Physical AC1024 Title_Block-ARCH dynamic graph output and readback

source.fixturePolicy: Existing local input was read in place. No DWG/DXF input or output fixture was added to Git; output files were temporary and removed by the selector.

profile.graph: Four nodes and three edges; exact typed fields and fresh wire group order compared between output readback and staged EvaluationGraph output.
profile.ownerRoles: The owner DICTIONARY preserves its three ordered keys and BLOCK_RECORD owner. EvaluationGraph and SORTENTSTABLE point back to the dictionary; dynamic node objects bind to graph nodes; PurgePreventer reactor and owner handles are checked against the raw emitted DXF record.
profile.visibility: The source and output visibility parameter each contain 117 unique handles covering their block definition. Four ordered visibility states contain 29 targets apiece; every source state target is remapped to the corresponding fresh-readback output handle.
profile.sortents: The source SORTENTSTABLE has 25 explicit pairs; the independently source-backed output profile expands to 117 pairs. The selector verifies both table owner/target roles and that all 25 mapped source targets remain in the emitted table. Exact table projection is covered by p4-ac1024-sortents-multitable-output-proof-2026-10-31.json.
profile.versionMapping: AC1024 EvalExpr source versions 29/2 are compared with the DXF schema identifiers 33/29; GripLocationComponent fields and visibility/grip bodies are checked by kind.
profile.boundary: Serializer and fresh DXF readback evidence only. This does not establish native dynamic-block behavior, CAD application acceptance, full document completeness, or a format-wide support claim.

qualification.result: PASS for the exact physical graph in both encodings; document strict-complete output remains refused at the unrelated VIEWPORT 0x52 callback.

negativeControls: An invalid physical LAYOUT BLOCK_RECORD target refuses output and preserves the destination sentinel and prior callback qualifications.
Removing one required visibility block target refuses output, preserves the destination sentinel, and publishes no callback qualification.
failureAndRetry.retry: Restore each source field and retry using the same adapter. The complete graph then exports and freshly imports in ASCII and Binary.
